summary.text: Leland J. Morgan, a Republican from Milton, represents Grand Isle-Chittenden in the Vermont House of Representatives, where he has served in 1985, 2019-2020, 2021-2022 and since 2025.
He sits on the House Committee on Education.

paragraphs.text: Morgan is a lifelong resident of Milton, was educated in the Milton school system, and is a graduate of the University of Vermont, according to his House biography.
His district covers Alburgh, Grand Isle, Isle La Motte, North Hero, South Hero and West Milton.
He is a retired military officer and a former small business owner.
He is a member of the Milton Selectboard and a Justice of the Peace, and he is married with two children and a granddaughter.
